pick.headline: US and China announce they will establish diplomatic relations
pick.summary: On December 15, 1978, President Carter and the Chinese government announced that the United States and the People's Republic of China would establish full diplomatic relations on January 1, 1979.
pick.significance: Normalization, with the end of US recognition of Taiwan, completed the strategic opening to China against the Soviet Union.
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of December 18, 1978, listed reports on US-PRC diplomatic relations from Tirana, Sofia, Prague, Bratislava, East Berlin and Budapest, including Carter's announcement.
